items.question: What expiatory and oblation duties must the father fulfill after the preceding rites?
premises: The preceding rites have already been completed near the fire.
An expiation is required as a subsequent ritual act.
A full oblation is to be offered as part of the sequence.
items.inference: Therefore the father must perform the expiation and then offer a full oblation.
uncertainties: The specific form or cause of the expiation is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Then, having performed the expiation, the father should offer a full oblation.
